command: Emit a lightweight Chisel harness around the pinned upstream ScratchpadBank(4096, 128, aligned_to=1, single_ported=false, use_shared_ext_mem=true, is_dummy=false), then connect its real ExtMemIO ready/valid ports to gemmini_spad_tensor_gateway and run directed plus randomized-backpressure equivalence. Do not invoke whole-Chipyard firtool.
expected_artifacts: generated lightweight ScratchpadBank SystemVerilog and hash
success_condition: Pinned upstream scratchpad read/write requests and responses traverse the project gateway without loss, duplication, reorder or unstable payload under backpressure; generated widths are exactly 4 banks x 4096 rows x 128 bits with 16 byte masks; zero timeout and upstream remains clean.
failure_policy: If lightweight Chisel emission still exceeds 10 GiB or fails in CIRCT, preserve the first root-cause slice and use the already generated FIRRTL module boundary for extraction; do not retry full-chip firtool, increase the memory cap, hand-write a substitute Gemmini endpoint, or mark L3 PASS.
